title: Dominic and the Letters
author: Felix Thornbury
blurb: Marguerite Kavanagh, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
